printers.model: Saturn 4 Ultra 16K + Mercury Plus V3 bundle

notes: Scraped 2026-09-03 from category listings /3d-yazici (93 items, 3 pages), /filament (685 items, 22 pages), /recine (103 items). Prices are the site's current KDV-dahil 'currentPrice' (schema.org offers/price), discounts already applied; out-of-stock items included. Printers: base and Combo/bundle SKUs listed separately because prices differ; wash/cure stations, AMS HT, CFS units and 3D pens excluded. H2D bed volume: 325x320x325 single-nozzle (350x320x325 total dual-nozzle envelope). X2D: 256x256x260 main nozzle (235.5x256x256 dual). H2C: 330x320x325 dual mode. Creator 5 (non-Pro) is open-frame without chamber heating; Snapmaker U1 and Flashforge Creator 5/5 Pro are 4-toolhead toolchangers (marked dualNozzleOrIdex=true). Guider 3 Ultra 330x330x600 single / 300x330x600 dual. Ender-3 V3/V3 Plus are CoreXZ (kinematics='other'); Snapmaker 2.0/Artisan are cartesian linear-module machines ('other'); OrangeStorm Giga is a cartesian XY-gantry ('other'). Specs primarily from robo90 product pages; gaps filled from manufacturer sites/search (Kobra X 1450W rated / ~400W printing, SparkX i7 700W, Hi 1150W, U1 1150W, HALOT-X1 350W, M7 Pro 240W, Mono 4/4 Ultra 66W, Mars 5 ~70W, Mars 5 Ultra 72W, Giga ~1530W peak, Creator 5 Pro 1200W). Zaxe X4 bed temp, Kobra 3 Max / S1 / QIDI Q2 / A2L / X2D / H2C rated power, M7 Max heater and Saturn 4 Ultra rated power not found (null). Halot-Max prints 1-4 s/layer (no mm/h figure). The site's XML product sitemap points to another store (metatechtr) and was ignored. Filaments: one row per brand+type; priceTRY is the median across colours (a few brands have special-colour premiums, e.g. Robo90 PLA+ 463.68 std vs 579.6 marble/night-blue; Flashforge PLA Pro 463.68-678.13). Bambu PLA Basic appears both as refill (1121.25) and with spool (1378.85). Resins: Elegoo 'standard' has two generations listed (782.46 and V2.0 ~826); Anycubic Water-Wash ABS-like 3.0 median of 1130.22-1275.12.
